note: BCA's Tahapan Xpresi, its savings account without a passbook, used as the everyday account: a monthly administration fee of 10,000 rupiah, no minimum average balance. Read again 2026-10-30: opens with 50,000 rupiah, by an adult from 17 (younger with a parent or guardian) with an identity card (KTP-el for a citizen; a passport and KITAS/KITAP for a foreigner living in Indonesia: the citizen's paper is written); BCA ATMs are free, a Prima or GPN machine 7,500 rupiah, abroad 20,000 rupiah a withdrawal; a transfer to another bank by BI-FAST 2,500 rupiah (online 6,500). Not stated: interest (only the deposit-insurance rate is referred to), overdraft, a returned payment, the card's share abroad.
